subject: MAP: CareBridge POC onramp — environment accelerator & close timeline
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Silva <elena@carebridge.health>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: CareBridge POC onramp — environment accelerator & close timeline

Hi Elena,

Great to meet you on the demo yesterday — thanks for the time. As discussed, I put together a compact mutual action plan (attached) that focuses on the POC environment items we agreed accelerate during evaluation:

- Org & tenant creation (carebridge.redwood)
- API keys (ephemeral + service account) and rotation cadence
- IP allowlist for our hosted endpoints and outbound egress rules
- VPC peering for the test tenant (staging) — CIDR and peering window needed

Suggested target close (internal): 3 business weeks from kickoff. To hit that we need two week windows for firewall/IP approval and one 2–4 hour peering test window.

Please review the attached MAP (carebridge_map_v1.xlsx) and confirm: 1) desired peering approach (VPC peering vs private link), 2) CIDR ranges we should expect, and 3) any procurement or SOW approvals required before we create tenant resources.

I’ve cc'd our enablers (Marissa and Neha) who will own org setup and API provisioning. I’ll coordinate the timeline and send a short calendar for the peering window once we lock the dates.

Attachments: carebridge_map_v1.xlsx (MAP spreadsheet)

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth onramp.

Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
A: +1 (415) 555-0172

---
Note: For security we will only send actual API keys via the secure provisioning portal; sample CSV in attachments is a stub for reference.

From: Elena Silva <elena@carebridge.health>

Cc: CareBridge NetOps <netops@carebridge.health>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: CareBridge POC onramp — environment accelerator & close timeline

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers from our side:

- We prefer VPC peering with our staging VPC first; private link for prod later.
- Staging CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16 (we can open a /24 for the peering tunnel).
- Procurement: a small SOW is required for the dedicated peering window; procurement will need the SOW doc and an estimated cost line.

Cc'ing our NetOps (netops@carebridge.health) — Miguel will own the firewall/IP allowlist and will coordinate with you on required egress rules.

Can Marissa confirm the expected artifacts we need to share with procurement and NetOps? Also what is the earliest peering window you can support?

—Elena

Thanks Elena — helpful. Quick follow-up and action owners:

1) SOW / procurement artifacts (Marissa): we will attach a short SOW addendum that covers the peering test window and limited engineering assistance. That should satisfy procurement for the trial.
2) Org & tenant provisioning (Marissa): we’ll provision carebridge.redwood.staging and seed two service accounts with ephemeral key rotation (7 day TTL) for the POC.
3) API keys (Neha): we will generate placeholder API credentials and provide the full secure provisioning link (not raw keys in email).
4) NetOps coordination (Elena/Miguel): please confirm the exact /24 you will allocate and whether you require BGP. For the POC we can do static routing — no BGP required.

Proposed dates:
- Week A (next Mon–Fri): procurement sign-off + peering ticket creation
- Week B (3rd business day): org provisioning and API seed
- Week B (end): peering window — 2–4 hour test (we’ll schedule on your preferred day)

If that timeline works we’ll lock the calendar invites.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1cAreBrID-map-v1 (MAP + sample SOW)
Attachments referenced: redwood_carebridge_sow_docusign.pdf (SOW draft), carebridge_map_v1.xlsx

Jasmine

Elena, Jasmine — I’ll take the SOW and the org provisioning tasks. Short checklist from my side:

- I will prepare the SOW addendum (redwood_carebridge_sow_docusign.pdf) and send to your procurement contact.
- Org creation: carebridge.redwood.staging (expected completion: 48 hours after SOW signature).
- API seed: I will upload a keys stub to the secure portal and will provide the provisioning link (do not paste keys in email).
- Ephemeral key rotation: default 7d but can adjust if you need 24h for tighter testing.

Attachments: api-keys-stub.csv (stub layout; not real keys).

Regarding artifacts for procurement: they will need the SOW (I’ll attach); an estimated cost line (I’ll include a $0 line for the staged peering test and a not-to-exceed engineering fee if needed).

I can support a peering window as early as next Thursday (29 Jul) afternoon — if that works for NetOps we’ll ticket it with our cloud partner and loop Jonas for scheduling.
